newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end down on finance firm problems.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end down on finance firm problems.

text.p: Thai stocks fell for the second day on Friday after investors sold shares on concerns that some finance firms faced cashflow problems after being hurt by loan defaults by clients in the property sector, brokers said.
The SET index stayed in the negative territory all day before closing 6.21 points lower at 938.30 on thin 3.3 billion baht turnover. Declines led advances 207 to 78.
"Investors sold almost across the board today on a market talk that some finance firms carried growing non-performing loans," said Witawus Charuchandr of Ekachart Finance.
Property developer Somprasong Land was hit by rumours of its cashflow problem early this month.
Somprasong, which denied the market talk, closed Friday at 8.10 baht, up 0.10.
"Political uncertainty was another negative factor sidelining investors today," Witawus said.
Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa called snap election last month after his coalition partners attempted to force him to step down after a no-confidence debate against him in parliament.
